title: State the actual coupled MHD stability interface
statement: About carrier(w,0),writing u=w+v gives v_t=-L_w v+nu Delta v+g and B_t=-w.gradB+B.gradw+rho Delta B. Lorentz P(B.gradB) and the v/B induction interactions are genuinely quadratic. A fundamental word followed by its inverse resets BOTH inviscid Euler-Q and magnetic-M blocks,not their viscous nonlinear errors automatically. With mu=min(nu,rho)>0,Y=||u||H1²+||B||H1²,Z²=||u||H2²+||B||H2², the local estimate is Yprime+mu Z²<=Cmu^-3Y³+Cmu^-1||f+h||². IF a strong pair exists on the WHOLE interval in L-infinity H1 intersect L2 H2,the relative energy of any same-data energy-weak pair obeys Eprime<=Cmu^-3(||grad u_s||2+||grad B_s||2)^4 E. The coefficient is integrable and E0=0 gives uniqueness of all weak solutions. This conditional uniqueness neither supplies global strong existence nor tolerates disturbances through a huge factor multiplying zero.

assumptions: Formal enhanced magnetic heat is not a physical finite controller. Both actual inviscid blocks must be reset and both moving-frame viscous/nonlinear errors controlled uniformly,without multiplying nonunitary bounds per sample. Local MHD estimates are not global regularity or simultaneous controllability. Ideal rho0 helicity does not establish a positive-resistivity impossibility. Nonzero mean magnetic field independently blocks a zero target on a torus. Liao-Sueur-Zhang2505.07366v1 concerns a bounded simply connected domain,control on the boundary of BOTH fields,Navier elsewhere,NONRESISTIVE equations and H24/H8 data; it does not transfer a mechanical-only periodic common-H1 polynomial theorem. Van Veen-Goto1512.02570v1 cubic Kolmogorov linear stability likewise does not prove generic carrier stability or a new MHD compiler. No source hold lifted.
costs: For EACH fixed integer m>=0,||M_±a||_(Hm->Hm)<=C_m(1+|a|)^(m+1),including all stretching terms. Twelve conjugates average exactly at the generator level; no finite switching duration,product approximation,commutator/high-frequency loss,paid transit error or simultaneous velocity stability budget is supplied. Coupled estimates use mu=min(nu,rho)>0. Large weak-strong factors times exactly zero difference prove uniqueness,not a nonzero disturbance tolerance.
